transcript:
This is NPR News Now, the latest headlines every hour.
>> Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Janine Herbst.
President Trump says on social media that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy ceasefire,
claiming both sides agreed to it even though Russia hasn't commented,
and Ukrainian President Zelensky says he found out about it when he read Trump's post.
But Alexander Meretsko, a member of Ukraine's parliament and the chair of its committee on foreign policy,
says there is no ceasefire.
>> In the morning, there were nonstop air raid alerts going off.
Then I heard loud, rather loud explosions, so we don't have any ceasefire or energy truce whatsoever.
And to me, this statement by President Trump came as quite a surprise.
>> Speaking there to NPR's All Things Considered,
Trump had recently blamed Zelensky for the rise in diesel prices that happened
after Trump started the war in Iran in February, which sent oil prices rising around the world.
Trump also had said Ukraine needs a new president.
There's been another missile attack at the passenger terminal at the Riyadh International Airport in Saudi Arabia.
Officials say there were injuries and that flights are still suspended.
And here's Aya Batrawi reports, this comes a day after a strike by Houthi rebels,
left at least 13 people dead, including an American and hundreds injured.
>> This is the deadliest attack on the capital, Riyadh, since 2015,
when Saudi Arabia led a coalition of countries into war in Yemen against the Iran-backed Houthis.
Prior to Saturday's attack, the Houthis had already hit Riyadh's airport twice,
piercing through Saudi Arabia's air defenses.
The group is also targeting airports in the south and east.
The Houthis have declared Saudi airspace and airports as theaters of operations,
with the exception, they say, of airports for Mecca and Medina.
The attacks come as Saudi forces and their Yemeni government allies carry out
hundreds of airstrikes and attacks on the Houthis to try and recapture Yemeni territory along the Red Sea.
Aya Batrawi, NPR News, Dubai.
Mathematicians are digging through hundreds of research papers and proofs,
released by the company OpenAI earlier last week.
And here's Jeff Brumfield reports, they've got their work cut out for them.
>> Among the more than 370 solutions generated by AI
was one for a longstanding problem in algebraic geometry.
Daniel Litt of the University of Toronto was initially excited
until he found a sign error that meant it was wrong.
>> OpenAI has now retracted the papers in question.
Litt says he still thinks the AI pushed out many brilliant solutions.
>> My hope is that we're able to extract interesting ideas and interesting understanding from them,
but that's like a lot of work.
>> Human mathematicians will have to read thousands of pages of AI-generated manuscripts
to see what they can learn.
Jeff Brumfield, NPR News.
>> And you're listening to NPR News from Washington.
>> Hurricane Simon, a Category 4 storm with maximum sustained winds of 145 miles an hour
is turning just off the coast of Mexico and the Pacific,
and it's expected to move inland later today as an extremely powerful storm.
Forecasters say Simon could bring 10 to 20 inches of rain over parts of southwestern Mexico,
and the National Hurricane Center says flooding and mudslides are possible.
The popular tourist destination of Puerto Vallarta boarded up windows on stores and hotels
and one state has already canceled school for tomorrow and started evacuations.
Pope Leo says he will undergo lung surgery this week, and Piers Eva Pukac has more.
>> Pope Leo made the announcement during his weekly blessing in St. Peter's Square.
He told the crowd doctors had found a localized nodule in the "very early stages" in his lung.
He says the doctors believe it is best to intervene
and is following their advice to undergo surgery to remove it.
Leo has had no known health problems.
The American Cancer Society says long nodules are most often the cause of old infections or scar tissue.
Most are benign, but tests are needed to determine whether the nodule is cancerous.
The Vatican says the surgery is scheduled for, quote, "the first days of this week,"
with recovery being about a week.
Eva Pukac and PR News.
Major League Baseball's National League Championship Series gets underway tonight
as the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Milwaukee Brewers start the "Best of Seven" matchup.
You're listening to NPR News from Washington.

topics.text: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agreed to energy ceasefire, which Ukrainian lawmaker Alexander Meretsko disputes
Missile attack hits passenger terminal at Riyadh International Airport in Saudi Arabia, injuring people and suspending flights
OpenAI retracts AI-generated math papers after mathematicians like Daniel Litt find errors in proofs
Hurricane Simon, a Category 4 storm, nears Mexico's Pacific coast with heavy rain and flooding expected
Pope Leo says he will undergo lung surgery this week to remove a localized nodule
Los Angeles Dodgers and Milwaukee Brewers begin National League Championship Series tonight
